scripts.dev: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) VITE_APP_PORT=$(port) BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) UI_PORT=8888 npm run x
scripts.dev:online: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) VITE_APP_PORT=$(port) BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) UI_PORT=8888 npm run x:online
scripts.x: hc s clean &&  npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run start:happ" "npm run local-services"
scripts.x:online: hc s clean &&  npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run start:happ:online"
scripts.launch:moss: concurrently "npm start -w ui" "sleep 1 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 1 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts" "sleep 10 && npm run weave -- --agent-idx 2 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts --sync-time 20000"
scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run launch:happ"
scripts.network:online: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run launch:online"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm t -w tests
scripts.launch:happ1: echo "pass" | RUST_LOG=warn hc launch --piped -n $AGENTS workdir/whosin.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT network mem
scripts.package: rm -rf ui/dist ui/dist.zip && npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive && npm run weave-hash
scripts.start:happ: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" echo "pass" |  WASM_LOG=debug RUST_LOG='debug,wasmer_compiler_cranelift=error,holochain::core::workflow=debug,cranelift_codegen=error,holochain::conductor::entry_def_store=debug' RUST_BACKTRACE=1 hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/whosin.happ --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a whosin network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" quic "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT/relay"
scripts.start:happ:online: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/whosin.happ  -s 1234 --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a whosin network -b "https://bootstrap.holo.host/" quic "https://bootstrap.holo.host/relay"
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zomes: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.release:webhapp: APP_VER=$(node -p "require('./ui/package.json').version") && git tag v$APP_VER && git push origin v$APP_VER
scripts.build:happ:release: npm run build:zomes && npm run optimize:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
